regions.name: Frostmarch
regions.description: A glacial mountain crown, buried keeps and windswept passes. Meltwater feeds the valleys below.

regions.name: Cinder Coast
regions.description: Black beaches, geothermal vents and basalt towers. A dangerous coast shaped by living fire.

regions.name: Westmere
regions.description: Deep inlets, exposed sea cliffs, fishing ports and fog-bound islands.

regions.name: Pineward
regions.description: The home region: sheltered pine valleys, ancient watch roads and timber villages beneath the peaks.

regions.name: Amberweald
regions.description: Copper-leaf forests, giant roots, secluded hunting lodges and shrines older than the towns.

regions.name: Sunscar Plateau
regions.description: The eastern rain shadow: dry highlands, wind-cut canyons, caravan towns and buried observatories.

regions.name: Highmeadow
regions.description: Open hills, grazing land, orchards and contested river crossings that keep the cities supplied.

regions.name: Glassfen
regions.description: Reed seas, mist, luminous pools and half-submerged ruins. Causeways connect isolated settlements.

locations.name: Frostmere
locations.description: Your starting village and the current playable area. The forge, Ember Hall, crossing and Watcher’s Stones are available on the local map.

locations.name: Pinehall
locations.description: A forest settlement and ruined archive reached by the western trail after Stonewake. The Lantern and Coven disagree over who should hold the recovered atlas.

locations.name: Wyrmkeep
locations.description: A snowy mountain settlement reached through the north pass after Stonewake. Two rival Iron Pact clans share a council hall and market.

locations.name: Rimegate Pass
locations.description: A narrow, strategic pass linking the northern clans and eastern coast.

locations.name: Ashport
locations.description: A harbor of black stone, furnace docks and contested pilgrimage routes.

locations.name: Ember Caldera
locations.description: A playable basalt sanctuary above volcanic channels. Cantor Sereth seeks the truth behind the awakening network; travel here after resolving the council.

locations.name: Saltbreak
locations.description: A playable fishing hamlet on the Black Shore. After The Missing Atlas, take the coastal road from Frostmere to investigate a fallen vessel.

locations.name: Hallowcliff
locations.description: A lighthouse monastery overlooking wreck-strewn waters.

locations.name: Alderrest
locations.description: A forest settlement divided over logging rights and its old woodland vows.

locations.name: The Stag Shrine
locations.description: A playable woodland chapter after Stonewake: rival keepers, three blighted roots, an ancient hollow-tree shrine and two permanent restoration pacts.

locations.name: Dunewell
locations.description: An oasis caravan town whose water rights are more valuable than gold.

locations.name: The Sunken Lens
locations.description: A playable buried observatory amid amber dunes. After The Missing Atlas, follow the eastern expedition road from Frostmere.

locations.name: Larksbridge
locations.description: A market and farming town at the meeting of the southern roads.

locations.name: Three Roads
locations.description: An inland trade stop: inns, stables, rumors and rival recruiters.

locations.name: Mirewatch
locations.description: A playable expedition camp on timber stilts above the marsh. Four investigations converge here to prepare a safe crossing.

locations.name: Reedhollow
locations.description: A marsh refuge where healers preserve knowledge unwelcome in the cities.

factions.name: Hearthbound Lodge
factions.goal: Protect travelers and the valley settlements.
factions.initiation: Restore the watch road and take a lodge oath.

factions.name: Iron Pact
factions.goal: Unite the northern holds without erasing their independence.
factions.initiation: Settle the council, choose one of the rival Stoneguard or Stormweaver clans, and restore the road wards.

factions.name: Veiled Lantern
factions.goal: Recover dangerous knowledge and control who can use it.
factions.initiation: Retrieve an archive fragment and submit to the order’s trial.

factions.name: Briar Coven
factions.goal: Preserve the old pacts between settlements and living land.
factions.initiation: Heal a blighted grove and choose which promise to keep.

factions.name: Sable Concord
factions.goal: Keep trade and knowledge outside the reach of rulers.
factions.initiation: Carry a sealed cargo through the canyon and answer for its contents.

factions.name: Ashen Choir
factions.goal: Awaken a buried power they believe can remake a failing world.
factions.initiation: Survive an ash pilgrimage and uncover what the choir conceals.

factions.name: Tidemarch Compact
factions.goal: Secure ports and trade routes through treaties and shared law.
factions.initiation: Investigate a missing ship and defend your findings before the houses.

quests.name: The Oldwatch Survey
quests.summary: Inspect the village forge, survey Oldwatch Crossing, then examine the relic at the Watcher’s Stones. This local exploration quest is playable now.

quests.name: Stonewake
quests.summary: After returning the forge ember to Edda, help Ilyra restore three ward stones. Decipher their runes, awaken the watchstone, and report echoes of worlds beyond Frostmere.

quests.name: The Divided Council
quests.summary: Hear both Wyrmkeep clans, recover the disputed road ledger from raiders, and broker a council settlement. Clan membership is optional.

quests.name: The Missing Atlas
quests.summary: Investigate Pinehall’s ruined archive, hear the Veiled Lantern and Briar Coven, and choose who receives the recovered atlas. The recipient unlocks a distinct relic pattern; either choice advances the main story.

quests.name: Pacts Beneath the Roots
quests.summary: Cleanse three blighted roots, defeat the Hollow Warden, and choose a wild or tended woodland pact to recover the ancient memory. Each pact unlocks different equipment.

quests.name: The Wreck on the Black Shore
quests.summary: Follow the recovered atlas to Saltbreak. Explore sea caves, restore wreck systems, identify damaged relics and decide whether the power core serves the harbor or the ship. Either outcome leads toward the Sunken Lens.

quests.name: The Sky Below the Sand
quests.summary: Explore the Sunken Lens, align three mirrors from their inscriptions, restore the observatory and defeat its guardian. Recover a star chart, solar-forging patterns and the piercing Sunlance spell. The atlas opens this parallel branch; either Black Shore outcome preserves its lead.

quests.name: A Song Through the Stone
quests.summary: Follow the council lead to Ember Caldera. Ring three resonators, repair the buried receiver and defeat its guardian to discover the distress signal behind the Choir's song.

quests.name: The Roads Converge
quests.summary: Bring the four discoveries to Mirewatch, forge a transit regulator and survive its live calibration. Earlier woodland and harbor choices remain valid; no faction membership is required.

quests.name: Beyond the First Threshold
quests.summary: Cross from the Sunken Lens after preparing the expedition. Restore an orbital station, defeat rogue security and bring its archive home to unlock Aeralis.

quests.name: The Returning Light
quests.summary: After returning from the First Threshold, enter Aeralis through Frostmere's crystal crossing. Recover the Dawn Prism from the fractured regent and return to stabilize the watchstone network.

quests.name: The Old Watch Road
quests.summary: Restore the watch road and take a lodge oath.

quests.name: A Winter Without Wolves
quests.summary: Track a sudden absence of wolves to a poisoned watershed. Work with a rival grove keeper or suppress the evidence to protect a village patron.

quests.name: Who Guards the Pass?
quests.summary: Choose whether the restored watch road belongs to a single clan or a neutral lodge. Your decision changes future patrols and village support.

quests.name: Blood at the Snow Line
quests.summary: Choose Stoneguard or Stormweaver, then restore three road wards to earn your first rank.

quests.name: The Broken Council
quests.summary: Provision two mountain supply posts to earn your first promotion and advanced clan patterns.

quests.name: A Crown of Separate Holds
quests.summary: After Shieldbearer promotion, harvest the colossus and Rimefang, then choose shared patrols under independent holds or a central war leader. Earn Clan Voice rank and a forgeable signet. The mandate changes clan reputation; it does not close other faction stories.

quests.name: The Uncatalogued Door
quests.summary: After The Missing Atlas, study the archivist’s testimony, solve the Uncatalogued Door and return to Mereth. Take the Lantern oath to become a Witness and earn a forgeable pendant. Your atlas custody decision remains intact.

quests.name: Names Beneath the Water
quests.summary: As a Lantern Witness, recover three Mirewatch records. Stabilize the expedition beacon to reach the sealed testimony, then return to Mereth. Publish the names or preserve them under seal to earn Recordkeeper rank and a choice-exclusive ring pattern.

quests.name: The Price of Knowing
quests.summary: After resolving the Mirewatch testimony, hear Mereth and Aelin, then choose sealed study, public copying or shared oversight at the archive seal. Earn Keeper rank and a forgeable keystone. The prior testimony decision remains intact; this first pass does not lock out the Coven capstone.

quests.name: The Grove That Refused Spring
quests.summary: After restoring the woodland memory, revive three settlement seedbeds and return to Maelin. Promise to shelter renewal or share medicine to become a Coven Seedkeeper and earn a forgeable charm. The earlier grove pact remains intact.

quests.name: A Debt of Sap and Stone
quests.summary: As a Seedkeeper, inspect the lodge foundation and Spring root, hear Oren, then negotiate a crossing or catchment with Maelin. Repair the settlement without expulsion and earn a forgeable Pactmender Ring.

quests.name: The Last Old Promise
quests.summary: After resolving the lodge debt, hear Maelin, Oren and the woodland memory. Renew the oldest protections or establish a shared charter at the Stag Heart. Earn Rootwarden rank and a forgeable talisman. Earlier pacts and Lantern records remain intact.

quests.name: The Unopened Cargo
quests.summary: Carry a sealed cargo through the canyon and answer for its contents. Playable through Dunewell caravan representatives in Frostmere and Wyrmkeep.

quests.name: Water for a Secret
quests.summary: Trade information for access to a stolen water ledger. Free the town from extortion without handing every route to the merchant houses. Playable through Dunewell caravan representatives in Frostmere and Wyrmkeep.

quests.name: The Road Without Kings
quests.summary: Choose an open network of independent routes or a profitable secret monopoly. Declaring war on the Compact closes its rival capstone. Playable through Dunewell caravan representatives in Frostmere and Wyrmkeep.

quests.name: Voices in the Furnace
quests.summary: Survive an ash pilgrimage and uncover what the choir conceals.

quests.name: Ash Remembers Everything
quests.summary: Enter a sealed furnace sanctuary and learn what happened during the last awakening. Challenge the choir’s account or help conceal the discovery.

quests.name: The Fire We Invite
quests.summary: Decide whether to awaken, contain, or silence the buried power. Choosing the Choir’s conquest path closes the Iron Pact’s rival capstone.

quests.name: A Ship Without a Name
quests.summary: Investigate a missing ship and defend your findings before the houses.

quests.name: The Harbor That Lied
quests.summary: Investigate forged harbor records connecting a merchant house to deliberate wrecks. Protect witnesses before presenting the evidence.

quests.name: The Price of Safe Passage
quests.summary: Rebuild the Compact through transparent agreements or let one house take control. Outlawing the Concord closes its rival capstone.

quests.name: An Ember Beneath Oldwatch
quests.summary: Speak with Edda at the village forge, descend beneath the Watcher’s Stones, defeat the Watch-Captain and recover the forge ember. Return to Edda for the Oldwatch Oath recipe.

quests.name: The Apprentice Who Vanished
quests.summary: Follow Iven’s healing research into the archive, help him return to camp and choose supervised college study or independent authorship.

quests.name: Letters Above the Snow
quests.summary: Carry two conflicting family accounts to the passkeepers’ memorial. Discover the shared final watch and choose public remembrance or private replies.

quests.name: The Last Warm Shelter
quests.summary: Find stranded travelers on the Rimegate approach outside Wyrmkeep. Restore the watch hut hearth, then arrange a cleared road home or shelter until a ridge guide can travel.

quests.name: The Boat That Would Not Burn
quests.summary: Investigate an Ashport launch beached at Saltbreak after a furnace fire. Harbor workers and a Choir archivist dispute its surviving cargo.

quests.name: A Pilgrim’s Empty Shoes
quests.summary: Track a missing pilgrim along the caldera ash paths. An apparent sacrifice conceals a staged escape; help Leth find shelter or leave freely.

quests.name: Nets Full of Silver
quests.summary: Follow silver coins from a fishing net to a smuggler’s ledger. Locate the missing crew and decide whether to publish the full account or protect their identities.

quests.name: The Keeper’s Last Light
quests.summary: Restore an old fjord signal on the Saltbreak shore to guide a Hallowcliff relief ship. Discover the keeper’s bargain and decide how to report it.

quests.name: A Harvest of Amber
quests.summary: Investigate blight at Alderrest’s trial plot in the woodland chapter. Test an herbal treatment, then preserve the grove or authorize limited emergency logging.

quests.name: The Stag Without a Shadow
quests.summary: Follow an uncanny stag without harming it. Its trail leads to a broken pact and a hunter who needs forgiveness rather than punishment.

quests.name: One Well, Two Owners
quests.summary: Resolve a water dispute between a caravan camp and an established household. Repairing the buried supply channel reveals a third claimant. Playable through the Dunewell well outpost in Wyrmkeep.

quests.name: The Astronomer’s Debt
quests.summary: Recover Veyra’s horizon gauge and weather prism from guarded excavation caches. Sell them to settle her debt, or retain them for public weather research.

quests.name: The Mill That Stopped
quests.summary: Investigate a stopped mill before the grain spoils. Sabotage, river damage and an unpaid worker’s grievance all point to different solutions. Playable through Larksbridge’s relief mill in Frostmere.

quests.name: Three Inns, One Secret
quests.summary: Compare contradictory stories from three innkeepers to locate a missing traveler. Someone is selling false routes to bandits. Playable through innkeepers in Frostmere, Saltbreak and Wyrmkeep.

quests.name: Lights Beneath the Boards
quests.summary: Investigate lights beneath Mirewatch’s western deck, free a trapped scavenger from a sealed service vault, and recover his salvage cache. Speak with Ilyra after the Mirewatch road opens.

quests.name: Medicine for the Unwelcome
quests.summary: Gather medicine for refugees whom the nearest town refuses to admit. Choose between a dangerous marsh shortcut and bargaining for safe passage. Playable through Reedhollow’s refugee camp in the woodland chapter.

quests.name: The Winter Siege
quests.summary: Defend Northwatch on Ember Caldera’s northern approaches after returning from Aeralis. Repel two waves, repair the fort defenses and recover orders that lead to the Broken Seal.

quests.name: The Broken Seal
quests.summary: Uncover the industrial force behind the invasion and assemble the ward needed to survive the Crucible.

quests.name: The Last Furnace
quests.summary: Much later, a siege and a broken ward expose the engine feeding the invasion. Descend into an industrial hell, defeat the Furnace Maw and recover its heart. Infernal guns and alloys can return home; ammunition remains a resource. Playable mini-world preview exists; earlier story acts remain planned.

local_sites.name: South Trail
local_sites.description: The village approach and your starting point.

local_sites.name: Village Forge
local_sites.description: Inspect the forge with E to begin the Oldwatch survey.

local_sites.name: Ember Hall
local_sites.description: The longhouse at the north end of the village.

local_sites.name: Oldwatch Crossing
local_sites.description: The old stone bridge connects the village to the eastern woods.

local_sites.name: Watcher’s Stones
local_sites.description: An ancient stone gateway. Inspect the relic just beyond it with E.

local_quest_steps.text: Examine the relic at the Watcher’s Stones
